title: Welcome Edgard Kagan | Andreessen Horowitz
gist: a16z Global Affairs (led by Anne Neuberger) has hired former U.S. Ambassador to Malaysia Edgard Kagan as an Advisor to help portfolio companies in AI infrastructure, cybersecurity and defense win government-linked adoption across the Indo-Pacific. A thin hiring announcement whose signal is a16z's continued build-out of a geopolitical go-to-market function for American tech abroad.

insights.claim: Andreessen Horowitz's Global Affairs team views Indo-Pacific countries as currently making long-lived choices about the technologies that will underpin their economies and security for decades, creating a time-sensitive window for American technology vendors.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
insights.so_what: Watch Indo-Pacific sovereign procurement of AI, cyber and defense tech as a lock-in moment for US vs. rival vendors.
insights.quote: Across the Indo-Pacific, countries are making decisions about the technologies that will underpin their economies and security for decades to come.

insights.claim: According to a16z's Anne Neuberger, selling AI infrastructure, cybersecurity tools, or defense capabilities into Indo-Pacific countries requires understanding each country's distinct needs, government decision-making processes, and partnerships, and these answers differ country by country.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
insights.so_what: Startups selling to foreign governments face a country-by-country go-to-market; investors backing them should value government-relations capability.
insights.quote: Those answers differ across countries, and understanding the differences is essential to building trust and making progress.

insights.claim: a16z's Global Affairs mission is to help its portfolio founders build partnerships that advance adoption of American technology abroad and strengthen the United States and its allies, positioning the venture firm as a geopolitical go-to-market partner.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
insights.so_what: a16z is differentiating on government/foreign-market access, a moat for its defense, cyber and AI-infra portfolio companies.
insights.quote: helping our founders build partnerships that advance the adoption of American technology and strengthen America and our allies.
insights.locator: That is central to our Global Affairs mission

insights.claim: a16z Global Affairs frames its goal as turning shared interests between the US and partner countries into practical capabilities: more secure infrastructure, stronger defenses, and technologies that help countries grow.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
insights.so_what: Signals a16z's tech-as-national-security positioning, relevant to allied-government demand for US defense and infrastructure-security startups.
insights.quote: Our goal is to turn shared interests into practical capabilities: more secure infrastructure, stronger defenses, and technologies that help countries grow and provide for their citizens.

insights.claim: a16z appointed Ambassador Edgard Kagan, former U.S. Ambassador to Malaysia under Presidents Biden and Trump and former NSC Senior Director for East Asia and Oceania, as an Advisor to a16z Global Affairs to advise the team and portfolio companies on Indo-Pacific government priorities and partnerships.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
insights.so_what: Continued revolving door from national-security officialdom into venture signals a16z doubling down on government-facing portfolio expansion in Asia.
insights.locator: Today, I'm pleased to welcome Ambassador Edgard Kagan

insights.claim: Edgard Kagan, newly an Advisor to a16z Global Affairs, holds the Freeman Chair in China Studies and is a Senior Adviser at CSIS, and previously served in diplomatic posts in New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, Mumbai, Beijing and Canberra and as Director of Korean Affairs.
insights.speaker: Anne Neuberger
entities: Center for Strategic and International Studies
insights.so_what: His footprint maps to India, Southeast Asia, China, Australia and Korea, hinting at where a16z portfolio companies may seek Indo-Pacific deals.
